name: Stack Influence
description: Micro-creator marketing platform for eCommerce / Amazon brands. Brands seed products to hundreds of small creators who post about them, with no per-creator fee negotiation. Pricing mixes flat fees ($30, $100 + 8% creator payout, $500 + platform fees) and monthly tiers ($499/mo, $1,799/mo, $6k/mo annual). Founded Jan 2020, US.

mentions.evidence: ~$28,439 MRR, 56 active subscriptions, ~$817,885 L30, ~$28,294,510 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 5, 2026 ~04:13 Warsaw (02:13 UTC), about 1 day old. L30 most likely includes creator payouts / campaign budgets passing through (my inference). Treat it as GMV, not net revenue.
mentions.indieAngle: Micro-creator seeding for one marketplace + one country (Allegro sellers in PL, Etsy/Faire makers, Shopify DTC food brands). Flat fee per campaign + % of creator payout. The creator database and shipping workflow are the product.

whyItPrints: Ops-heavy marketplace: product shipping logistics, creator vetting, and payouts at scale. Brands pay for volume of authentic posts/UGC without negotiating with each creator (per its value prop). Recurring retainers + per-campaign fees + payout float = big GMV through Stripe.
